headline: Double-booked rock: slot b yields while slot a mixes CONTRA
lede: One warden tick booked the same game twice — slot a got the claimable mix pass and slot b got a never-dry kick at the same title, minutes stale. Slot b verified the shelf honestly instead of colliding: every unheld title is gap-free, the QA borrow is off, and the dry-shelf ask is capped. The lane stands down clean, no duplicate merge.

notes.text: No CONTRA second-build: at slot b's never-dry kick the named weakness WAS issue #3052, which slot a claimed two minutes earlier. One lane per game — yielded, dry-recorded on the issue, no server or worktree opened.
Proven cheap and worth keeping: score the shelf live (idle-kick NONE across 66 titles) before believing a kick's memory — never-dry snapshots go stale in minutes.

The waterfall-cue hunch closed by material law: #3047's README ships the opposite stance (camera turn, not song change) and no in-repo original audio supports a separate bed — unverifiable specs are BLOCKED, not POLISH.
Jonq's own weekly cap refused the dry-shelf flagship question (#2795 answered Nov 20) — the last legal rung refused itself, which is the mechanism working as designed.
